context_notes: The AktiiviLogo bump (uloke) protrudes from the top of the bottom sheet. Visually it looks 'irtonainen' (disconnected/floating) because the glass surface has no visible edge definition where the clip-path cuts. Tried: drop-shadow filter, SVG sibling stroke, inner SVG stroke. All unsatisfactory. The technical root cause is that clip-path clips all CSS border properties.
